I approved `paper-repo`#5 from the figures-and-tables side.

- **Tables:** every file under `tables/` in the PR is identical to my `main` (7fa22cb).

- **Not checked:** I checked only Fig. 2 in that build visually.

My review comment says that refreshing the PR to `dev` brings in the compact figures.
